role: RuntimeException thrown by the texture atlas Stitcher when a sprite cannot be placed, carrying the offending Holder.
scope_reason: The native engine never re-stitches the atlas: it consumes the oracle's stitched atlas (atlas.json uv ranges and the dumped sheet), so the stitch-failure path cannot exist there.

members.name: field_98149_a
members.note: diagnostic payload of an exception that is never thrown in the native engine

notes: Error-path class; no behavioural surface to port. The stitched atlas the native engine reads is described in csrc/engine/render_blocks.h's probe-directory contract (atlas.json).
